points: Runway releases its robotics model Praxis-1 with open weights and source code under the Apache 2.0 license.
The model uses knowledge from video training for robot control and leads the World Action Model category on Nvidia's RoboLab-120 benchmark.
It can't yet plan complex action sequences on its own, though.

stories.title: Verify by Doing: Co-Evolving Agent Execution and Evaluation without External Feedback
stories.originalTitle: Verify by Doing: Co-Evolving Agent Execution and Evaluation without External Feedback
stories.summary: arXiv:2611.15276v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agent self-improvement requires feedback about task success, yet external feedback may be unavailable at test time. Agents must then infer success from observable evidence, and incomplete verification can misguid
points: arXiv:2611.15276v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agent self-improvement requires feedback about task success, yet external feedback may be unavailable at test time.
Agents must then infer success from observable evidence, and incomplete verification can misguide subsequent updates.
We introduce Verify by Doing (VbD), a method that co-evolves Actor and Evaluator harnesses within a single task while keeping model weights fixed.
